purpose: Source-specific documentation/schema appraisal before any selected clinical-record intake or fit for issue 57.
prior_inspection: Primary publication methods/access statements, derivative README/tree metadata and code-cell sources were inspected. Publication results were incidentally exposed. No independent holdout or blinded clinical assessment is claimed.
design_chain: Health parts of Q-03/RM-04 -> P-02 -> I-01/I-07/I-11/I-12 -> F-04/F-08 -> T-01/T-05/T-06/T-08; L-00 bookkeeping only.

derivative_repository.permission_scope: Available public primary-study data are described as CC0; derivative code is MIT. Neither establishes membership/rights for an unverified copy or controlled-consent subset. No clinical source file is admitted by this protocol.

selected_schema_document.worksheet_identity: Table S0: Listing of Clinical Laboratory Measures, Immune Proteins and Cardiovascular Biomarkers
selected_schema_document.worksheet_name_selection: Case-insensitive complete worksheet name matching (Table with optional space/underscore/hyphen prefix)? S0, with an optional descriptive suffix separated by space/underscore/hyphen. Require one unambiguous match and the documented table identity; otherwise stop with a failed/unresolved binding.
selected_schema_document.permitted_inspection: Workbook structural metadata and the selected S0 worksheet only. Record assay/measure names, stated platform/method and explicit units, plus exact cell locators. No guessed units, numerical thresholds, clinical categories or outcome arithmetic.
selected_schema_document.excluded: All other supplement worksheet contents, health discoveries, cohort/outcome tables, notebook outputs, and participant record rows/values.
selected_schema_document.storage: Full publication supplement is fetch-only in ignored storage; do not redistribute it. Selected factual schema metadata and source receipts may be reported separately. Retain exact original bytes/hash and the distinction between a fetched mixed document and inspected S0 content.

selected_header_metadata.text_transport: Read only through the first header newline, then close the response without consuming remaining rows. Save partial-header bytes/receipt, explicitly not a full-file hash match. Abort and redact a first line inconsistent with a labeled header; no search through record rows.
selected_header_metadata.xlsx_transport: The binary workbook must be fetched to inspect its structure. Record that actual file acquisition honestly, verify its pinned Git blob, retain only in ignored fetch-only storage, and inspect row 1 only. If row 1 is not clearly labeled header metadata, stop/redact; do not search later rows.
selected_header_metadata.permitted_fields: Schema labels only: assay/measure columns, subject/sample/visit key labels, clock labels, context/history/treatment/stop field labels. Do not output participant identifiers or any record values.
selected_header_metadata.rights_and_use: Public producer repository metadata inspection only. This does not verify consent membership, public-release date coverage or clinical reuse permission for a full derivative panel; no participant rows, threshold mapping, numerical outcome intake, fit or distribution is admitted.

coverage_questions: Assay names/units and raw versus normalized values remain distinct.
clinical_tests VisitID -> producer-renamed SampleID is only a code-level join; test actual key cardinality later.
Original clinical CollectionDate is dropped by the producer analysis. Days_Since_Start origin, time units and calendar/release mapping are not assumed.
CL1..CL4 exist in clinical_tests but their roles remain unresolved. subjectStatus.CL4 visit-context use does not establish those roles.
Whole-follow-up SubjectClass cannot become a visit state, baseline state or onset date.
Public consent/release membership, cutoff and overlap of the different study/analysis cohorts require file-level provenance.
Fasting, scheduled/event visits, missing tests, diagnosis/type history, treatment, death, last contact and stopping reasons need separate bindings. Absence is unknown, not zero.

clinical_estimation.candidate_later_target: Native-cohort usual-care laboratory observations if their definitions, clocks, selection and rights support them. This is not a registered clinical likelihood or national hazard estimate.
clinical_estimation.required_next_protocol: Freeze exact eligible release, specimen/participant keys, observed-variable meaning, measurement/observation process, exclusions, estimand/operator, joint uncertainty and evaluation plan before selected clinical numerical intake or fitting.
prohibited_inferences: Treating missing visits or missing death fields as independent censoring or zero mortality
Converting normalized omics signals into diagnostic laboratory values
Equating a laboratory category with comprehensive metabolic health, retained T2D or sustained remission
National initialization/transport, isolated dietary effects, engine activation or clinical acceptance

acquisition_flags_meaning: These are the state when the schema protocol is frozen, not promised post-fetch outcomes. Later receipts must distinguish text header requests/partial bytes, full binary workbook acquisition and selected-content inspection.
